Decision: Accept P023 as a new high-value primary experimental HEA source.
Scientific_Rationale: Direct processing-dependent phase fractions plus direct post-tensile TRIP/HCP-twinning evidence are available.
Implementation_Rule: Assign P023 with one material parent, ten processing states, and seven primary tensile conditions.

Decision: Only 650-15 and 850-30 receive direct joint TRIP/TWIP labels.
Scientific_Rationale: These two conditions have explicit before/after EBSD phase fractions and direct epsilon-phase twinning/slip evidence.
Implementation_Rule: 650-15 and 850-30: TRIP=1, TWIP=1, Slip=1; others remain NA unless direct evidence exists.

Scientific_Rationale: The paper explicitly attributes twinning to the HCP epsilon phase.
Implementation_Rule: Store TWIP_Phase=HCP_EPSILON; do not silently reinterpret as FCC twinning.

Decision: Initial HCP fractions are pre-test processing states, not tensile TRIP.
Scientific_Rationale: FSP/annealing/quenching produces 3-70% HCP before loading depending on condition.
Implementation_Rule: TRIP requires before/after FCC loss/HCP gain during tensile deformation.

Decision: Do not use WH-curve interpretation alone to label unresolved conditions.
Scientific_Rationale: The authors discuss transformation stresses for multiple conditions, but direct condition-specific phase evidence is only shown for selected states.
Implementation_Rule: Preserve WH interpretation as supporting evidence/model-curve inference; keep effective targets NA for unresolved conditions.

Decision: Keep local EDS separate from bulk composition.
Scientific_Rationale: Fig.1e provides quantitative local EDS values for as-cast and D-pass states but not a bulk chemical analysis.

Decision: Do not digitize annealed grain-size and Al-matrix-content curves.
Scientific_Rationale: Fig.3g-h show trends without direct table values.
Implementation_Rule: Preserve qualitative trend only; no numeric recovery from curves.

Decision: Keep TRIP onset ~924 MPa as curve-inferred, not direct experimental stage.
Scientific_Rationale: Onset is derived from a WH slope change and author mechanism interpretation.
Implementation_Rule: Store as MODEL_CURVE_INFERENCE_NOT_DIRECT_STAGE; do not create interrupted-test child.

Scientific_Rationale: No current-paper alloy-specific numeric SFE or DeltaG is reported.
